intro: Everything you need to know about attending or registering for XHOCK.

items.question: Do I need a team to register?
items.answer: No. You can register as an individual player. XHOCK will assign you to a team so you can compete, connect with new friends and live the tournament experience.

items.question: What do I need to bring to the tournament?
items.answer: All you need is your hockey equipment, a competitive attitude, the desire to make friends and have fun.

items.question: Can I register with friends?
items.answer: Yes. Bring as many friends as you like—the more friends, the more competitive and fun it gets.

items.question: What does my registration include?
items.answer: Your participation in the tournament, the commemorative jersey, activities and additional experiences.

items.question: Can I attend with someone who isn't playing?
items.answer: Yes. Companions can attend activities that are open to the public, although some experiences may be exclusive to players.

items.question: What does XHOCK mean?
items.answer: XHOCK represents a new way to experience hockey: more intense, more social and more experiential. It's the shock of living the unexpected.

items.question: Why XHOCK?
items.answer: Because hockey doesn't end when the whistle blows. It's the experience beyond the game.

items.question: Are hotel packages available?
items.answer: Yes. International visitors can access exclusive rates at selected partner hotels recommended by XHOCK.
